item.text: The diagnosis holds: each write stores `Fields` as a string, and the read paths decode it. I’ll convert JSON values directly into DynamoDB attribute values so empty strings, empty collections, numbers, and nulls survive the change.

item.text: The main patch is in place. New events write `FieldsMap`; reads accept either format; migration scans legacy rows under a distributed lock, validates each conversion, and writes batches with retries. I’m compiling and checking the integration tests now.

package dynamoevents

import (
	\"encoding/json\"
	\"testing\"

	\"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/aws\"
	\"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/dynamodb\"
	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestFieldsMapConversion(t *testing.T) {
	original := []byte("'`{"empty":"","object":{},"list":[],"null":null,"nested":{"flag":true,"number":12.50},"array":["",{},[],null]}`)
	fields, err := fieldsMapFromJSON(original)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "", aws.StringValue(fields["empty"].S))
	require.NotNil(t, fields["object"].M)
	require.NotNil(t, fields["list"].L)
	require.Equal(t, "12.50", aws.StringValue(fields["nested"].M["number"].N))
	require.NoError(t, sameEventJSON(original, fields))

	item, err := marshalEvent(event{SessionID: "session", EventIndex: 1, FieldsMap: fields})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotContains(t, item, "Fields")
	require.Equal(t, fields, item["FieldsMap"].M)
	var restored event
	require.NoError(t, unmarshalEvent(item, &restored))
	data, err := eventJSON(&restored)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var decoded map[string]interface{}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &decoded))
	require.Equal(t, "", decoded["empty"])

	legacy := map[string]*dynamodb.AttributeValue{"Fields": {S: aws.String(string(original))}}
	require.NoError(t, unmarshalEvent(legacy, &restored))
	data, err = eventJSON(&restored)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, string(original), string(data))
}

func TestFieldsMapRejectsMalformedData(t *testing.T) {
	for _, input := range []string{"", "[]", "{bad}", `{"x": 1} true`} {
		_, err := fieldsMapFromJSON([]byte(input))
		require.Error(t, err)
	}
	fields, err := fieldsMapFromJSON([]byte(`{"x":"value"}`))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Error(t, sameEventJSON([]byte(`{"x":"other"}`), fields))
}
EOF
